title: LightGBM Sector-Neutral Cross-Sectional Momentum
source: arXiv:2507.07107 — ML Enhanced Multi-Factor Quantitative Trading
summary: LightGBM with Bayesian HPO applied to cross-sectional factor selection; paper demonstrates outperformance vs CSI300. Provides production hyperparameter template (1000-3000 estimators, lr 0.05-0.1, GOSS+EFB).

features: Momentum ranks: cross-sectional rank of each lag within sector
Technical: RSI-14, MACD signal, ATR-14 (via TA-Lib)
Fundamental: P/E, P/B, earnings revision (if available via FMP API)
design.model: LightGBM with GOSS+EFB; Bayesian HPO via optuna
design.signal: Cross-sectional rank of model predictions each month
design.portfolio: Long top quintile (>0.8), short bottom quintile (<0.2); sector-neutral within quintiles

success_criterion: OOS Sharpe >= 0.8, IC > 0.04, ICIR > 0.4 (Alphalens-Reloaded validation first)
effort: HIGH — 3-5 days for feature pipeline + cross-sectional backtest infrastructure
implementation_resources: ml-for-trading.md wiki — LightGBM section, Alphalens-Reloaded section
